summary: Only staff who maintain AAP components should log in to the underlying RHEL servers, since they hold encryption keys and service passwords; never grant untrusted users sudo to root or the service accounts `awx`, `pulp` and `postgres`. Service accounts created by the RPM installer can't come from an external auth source.
questions: Who should have SSH access to AAP servers?
What are the AAP local service accounts?
Can AAP service accounts like awx come from LDAP?
Should I give sudo to the awx user?
